emily_cs: Quick flag 028: ACME Retail (ACCT ACME-77) renewal in ~28 days. Usage down ~35% MoM; onboarding stalled at connectors. Proposing a short enablement burst + 2-week credit runway + temporary scaled-down plan with data-retention hold to avoid churn. Thoughts?

sam_ae: Can you confirm MRR and primary contact? I can reach out if we need a call.

emily_cs: MRR ~$4.5k. Primary contact @maria_acme. She replied "too slammed" to email. High-signal call might work.

jordan_support: Noted. Two tickets open related to SSO + CSV import (tickets #5421, #5433). Those line up with the connectors blockage. I can triage and prioritize the import fix. :white_check_mark:

matt_product: If connectors are the drag, we can ship a feature toggle to relax the import schema and expose a simple import script. Will prepare PR.
emily_cs: Draft plan: 1) 2-hr enablement session (CS + Eng) within 72h; 2) 2-week promo credit (`ACME_RUNWAY_2W`) covering overages; 3) Offer temporary "core" plan (reduced seats, read-only retention) to buy time; 4) Post-session 2-question feedback + optional NPS.
sam_ae: Who handles the outbound offer email + updated quote? I can send outreach but need the exact wording and finance approval for the credit.
emily_cs: I'll write the email. @sam_ae attach revised quote. @finance-team - pls weigh in on approving one-off credit code `ACME_RUNWAY_2W`.
onboard-bot: Automated check: onboarding_progress=42%. last_activity="connectors attempted 3 days ago". open_tickets=["#5421","#5433"].
jordan_support: If eng flips the relaxed-schema flag I can clear the CSV import bug by EOD.
matt_product: PR opened: https://internal/repo/pulls/987 toggle=`allow_schema_relax=true`. Notes for import script included.
emily_cs: Proposed timeline: T+0-24h finance/legal check -> T+24-72h enablement session + import toggle live -> T+72h-14d credits active and monitor -> end of runway reconvene for renewal conversation and offer scaled renewal if needed.
sam_ae: I'll draft outreach and post to #sales-drafts. Will cc Maria for scheduling.
jordan_support: Tickets updated with runbook notes and Ill coordinate session times with CS schedule.
emily_cs: Assignment checklist: Emily = offer email + enablement agenda; Sam = revised quote + outreach; Jordan = ticket ownership + enablement support; Matt = feature flag PR + import script standby; Finance = approve credit.
emily_cs: Compliance/legal note 028: ensure data-retention hold for scaled plan is captured in PO/quote. @legal FYI.
sam_ae: Posted draft email + quote link in thread, promo `ACME_RUNWAY_2W` included.
onboard-bot: Reminder created: follow-up check 3 days after enablement session.
emily_cs: If no objections, I'll execute tomorrow morning. Will post final email + calendar invite here. :thumbsup:
